_readme: Clause-level corpus for retrieval. These are SHORT PARAPHRASED SUMMARIES written by the team for the prototype (source_status = summary), each pointing to its APH location. Run scripts/ingest_aph.py on the official APH 2024-27 PDF to replace them with verbatim clause text and page numbers. 'to_verify' marks items whose exact 2024-27 wording/number the team must still confirm.

clauses.chapter: Chapter II: Changes in existing institutions
clauses.title: Increase in intake / additional courses: overview
clauses.text: Existing institutions may seek an increase in intake or additional courses. Approval depends on infrastructure readiness and filled faculty positions, verified through an Expert Visit Committee (EVC). One supernumerary division of 30/60 seats in an Indian/regional language may be permitted.

clauses.title: Expansion in proportion to infrastructure and faculty
clauses.text: An existing institution may expand intake or add courses only in proportion to the additional equivalent infrastructure, facilities and faculty it provides.

clauses.title: Eligibility for increase in intake
clauses.text: To be eligible for new or expanded courses the institution must comply with the infrastructure norms of the APH, the prescribed faculty-student ratio, and submit the additional documents listed in the APH for that application type.

clauses.title: Three core branches before expansion
clauses.text: For Diploma, UG or PG expansion in Engineering and Technology the institution must already offer at least three courses in core branches, including multidisciplinary and region-specific branches listed in the annexure. This does not apply to courses in regional languages.

clauses.title: Building plan by registered architect; built-up area for total intake
clauses.text: The building plan must be prepared by an Architect registered with the Council of Architecture or by a licensed surveyor. Infrastructure for the first year must be fully complete. Common facilities must serve the total approved intake, and the built-up area must equal the sum of the requirements for each expansion.

clauses.title: No increase while inquiries are pending
clauses.text: No increase in intake is permitted where an inquiry by a central or state investigating agency is pending against the institution.

clauses.title: Reduction of core-branch intake
clauses.text: Intake in core branches may be reduced by up to 50% of the previously approved intake, subject to a minimum of 30.

clauses.title: Deficiencies when students were not admitted
clauses.text: If an institution received a Letter of Approval but did not admit students because of non-affiliation or unmet State/UT requirements, faculty and infrastructure deficiencies are counted from the year students are admitted.

clauses.chapter: Appendix 7: Faculty norms and cadre ratio
clauses.title: Faculty-student ratio, Diploma
clauses.text: Diploma and Post Diploma programmes in Engineering and Technology follow a faculty-student ratio of 1:25, including one Principal and one Head of Department per department.

clauses.title: Faculty-student ratio, Undergraduate
clauses.text: Undergraduate Engineering and Technology programmes follow a faculty-student ratio of 1:20. Planning is 1:16; Applied Arts and Crafts and Design are 1:15; Hotel Management and Catering Technology is 1:20.

clauses.title: Faculty-student ratio, Postgraduate
clauses.text: Postgraduate Engineering and Technology follows 1:15; Planning 1:10; MCA and MBA/PGDM 1:20; Hotel Management 1:12.

clauses.title: How required faculty is computed
clauses.text: Required faculty = S divided by the ratio, where S is the sum of approved intake across all years of the course. For UG Engineering, total faculty = S/20. Professors = S x 1/(20 x 9), Associate Professors = S x 2/(20 x 9), Assistant Professors = S x 6/(20 x 9).

clauses.title: Cadre ratio Professor : Associate : Assistant
clauses.text: For undergraduate programmes the cadre ratio is 1:2:6 (R = 9). Postgraduate starred programmes use 1:1:1; MCA and MBA/PGDM use 1:2:6. If a qualified Professor is not available, an Associate Professor may be considered against that position. The cadre ratio does not apply at Diploma level.

clauses.title: Reduced faculty requirement for low admissions
clauses.text: If average admissions over the last three years are at or below 50% of the average sanctioned intake, the faculty requirement is reduced by 25%. Example: 300 sanctioned seats need 60 faculty; with 130 admitted the requirement falls to 45.

clauses.title: Adjunct faculty and resource persons
clauses.text: From 2023-24, adjunct faculty and resource persons may make up to 10% of the faculty strength.

clauses.chapter: AICTE Regulations on qualifications for teachers (2019)
clauses.title: Minimum qualifications by cadre (Engineering)
clauses.text: Assistant Professor in Engineering and Technology requires a Bachelor's and Master's degree in the relevant branch with first class in either. Associate Professor and Professor require a Ph.D. in the relevant field in addition to experience and research requirements.

clauses.title: Land and building on lease
clauses.text: Land or building held on lease is acceptable if the registered lease is for at least 30 years and at least 25 years of the lease remain live on the date of application.

clauses.title: Built-up area is the key criterion
clauses.text: Land requirements are the same for rural, semi-urban, metro and mega-metro locations, subject to providing the required built-up area. The total built-up area is the key infrastructure criterion.

clauses.chapter: Appendix: Land and built-up area norms
clauses.title: Built-up area by programme and intake
clauses.text: The minimum built-up area (instructional, administrative and amenities areas) depends on the programme and the approved intake. For the prototype the requirement is computed as a base area plus an area per seat of annual intake; the exact table must be copied from the APH 2024-27 appendix.

clauses.chapter: Appendix: Land and built-up area norms
clauses.title: Access and circulation area
clauses.text: Access and Circulation Area is counted as 25% of the built-up area.

clauses.title: Documents for Extension of Approval
clauses.text: For Extension of Approval the institution uploads an affidavit and undertaking, the occupancy or completion certificate, and the faculty list with qualification, designation and date of joining, along with other documents listed for the application type.

clauses.title: Documents for increase in intake
clauses.text: For an increase in intake the institution additionally submits the land documents, the approved building plan prepared by a registered architect, the occupancy certificate, fire safety certificate, trust or society registration, the faculty list and photographs of the facilities.

clauses.title: Fire safety certificate
clauses.text: A fire safety certificate (NOC) issued by the competent fire authority for the campus buildings must be valid on the date of application.

clauses.title: Occupancy / completion certificate
clauses.text: An occupancy or completion certificate issued by the competent authority must cover the buildings and built-up area declared by the institution.

clauses.title: Notarised affidavit
clauses.text: The institution submits an affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper, duly notarised, declaring that the information provided is true. The trust or society name and intake declared must match the application.

clauses.title: Penal action for false information
clauses.text: If information submitted by an institution is found to be false or documents are found fabricated, the Council may take penal action including withdrawal of approval, reduction of intake or a no-admission status.

clauses.title: Expert Visit Committee verification
clauses.text: An Expert Visit Committee verifies the infrastructure, facilities and faculty claimed by the institution, particularly for increase in intake, and reports deficiencies to the Council.

clauses.title: Courses for new engineering institutions
clauses.text: New engineering institutions must offer at least three core branches plus one course in an emerging area.
